# 1 Kings Chapter 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Then Solomon assembled ʾet-the-elders-of Israel and-ʾet-all the-heads-of the-tribes, the-leaders-of the-fathers-of the-sons-of Israel, to the-king Solomon, to-Jerusalem, to-bring-up ʾet-the-ark-of the-covenant-of YHWH from-the-City-of David — it is Zion.

**2** And-all the-men-of Israel assembled to the-king Solomon at-the-feast, in-the-month-of Ethanim — it is the-seventh month.

**3** And-all the-elders-of Israel came, and-the-priests took-up ʾet-the-ark.

**4** And-they-brought-up ʾet-the-ark-of YHWH, and-ʾet-the-tent-of meeting, and-ʾet-all the-holy vessels that were in-the-tent. And-the-priests and-the-Levites brought-them-up.

**5** And-the-king Solomon and-all the-congregation-of Israel who-assembled to-him were with-him before the-ark, sacrificing sheep and-cattle that could-not be-numbered or-counted from-multitude.

**6** And-the-priests brought ʾet-the-ark-of the-covenant-of YHWH to its-place, to the-inner-sanctuary-of the-house, to the-Holy-of-Holies, to beneath the-wings-of the-cherubim.

**7** For the-cherubim spread wings to the-place-of the-ark, and-the-cherubim covered over the-ark and-over its-poles from-above.

**8** And-the-poles were-long, and-the-tips-of the-poles were-seen from the-Holy-Place before the-inner-sanctuary, but-they-were-not seen from-outside. And-they-are there to this day.

**9** There-was-nothing in-the-ark except the-two tablets-of stone that Moses placed there at-Horeb, when YHWH cut a-covenant with the-sons-of Israel, when-they-came-out from-the-land-of Egypt.

**10** And-it-was when-the-priests came-out from the-Holy-Place, and-the-cloud filled ʾet-the-house-of YHWH.

**11** And-the-priests could-not stand to-minister because-of the-cloud, for the-glory-of YHWH filled ʾet-the-house-of YHWH.

**12** Then Solomon said, "YHWH said he-would-dwell in-the-thick-darkness.

**13** I-have-surely-built a-house-of exaltation for-you, a-place for-your-dwelling forever."

**14** And-the-king turned ʾet-his-face and-blessed ʾet-all the-assembly-of Israel, and-all the-assembly-of Israel was-standing.

**15** And-he-said, "Blessed is YHWH, the-God-of Israel, who spoke with-his-mouth to David my-father, and-with-his-hand has-fulfilled, saying,

**16** 'From the-day that I-brought-out ʾet-my-people ʾet-Israel from-Egypt, I-did-not choose a-city from-all the-tribes-of Israel to-build a-house for-my-name to-be there. But-I-chose David to-be over my-people Israel.'

**17** And-it-was with the-heart-of David my-father to-build a-house for-the-name-of YHWH, the-God-of Israel.

**18** And-YHWH said to David my-father, 'Because it-was with your-heart to-build a-house for-my-name, you-did-well that it-was with your-heart.

**19** Only, you shall-not build the-house; but your-son who-comes-out from-your-loins — he will-build the-house for-my-name.'

**20** And-YHWH has-established ʾet-his-word that he-spoke. And-I-have-risen in-place-of David my-father, and-I-sit on the-throne-of Israel, as YHWH spoke. And-I-have-built the-house for-the-name-of YHWH, the-God-of Israel.

**21** And-I-have-set there a-place for-the-ark, where is the-covenant-of YHWH that he-cut with our-fathers when-he-brought-them-out from-the-land-of Egypt."

**22** And-Solomon stood before the-altar-of YHWH, in-the-presence-of all the-assembly-of Israel, and-spread-out his-palms toward the-heavens.

**23** And-he-said, "YHWH, God-of Israel, there-is-no God like-you in-the-heavens above or-on the-earth beneath — keeping the-covenant and-the-ḥesed for-your-servants who-walk before-you with-all their-heart,

**24** who kept for-your-servant David my-father ʾet-what you-spoke to-him. And-you-spoke with-your-mouth, and-with-your-hand you-fulfilled, as-this day.

**25** And-now, YHWH, God-of Israel, keep for-your-servant David my-father ʾet-what you-spoke to-him, saying, 'There-shall-not be-cut-off for-you a-man from-before-me sitting on the-throne-of Israel — only if your-sons guard their-way, to-walk before-me as you-walked before-me.'

**26** And-now, God-of Israel, let-your-word be-confirmed, please, that you-spoke to your-servant David my-father.

**27** For will-God truly dwell upon the-earth? Behold, the-heavens and-the-heavens-of the-heavens cannot contain-you — how-much-less this house that I-have-built!

**28** And-turn to the-prayer-of your-servant and-to his-plea, YHWH my-God, to-hear the-cry and-the-prayer that your-servant prays before-you today —

**29** that your-eyes may-be open toward this house night and-day, toward the-place of-which you-said, 'My-name shall-be there,' to-hear the-prayer that your-servant prays toward this place.

**30** And-hear the-plea-of your-servant and-of your-people Israel, when they-pray toward this place. And-you — hear in-the-place-of your-dwelling, in-the-heavens. And-hear, and-forgive.

**31** When a-man sins against his-neighbor, and-an-oath is-laid upon-him to-make-him-swear, and-he-comes and-swears before your-altar in-this house —

**32** then you, hear in-the-heavens, and-act, and-judge ʾet-your-servants, condemning the-guilty, to-bring his-way upon his-head, and-justifying the-righteous, to-give to-him according-to his-righteousness.

**33** When your-people Israel is-defeated before an-enemy because they-sinned against-you, and-they-return to-you and-confess ʾet-your-name, and-pray and-plead-for-grace before-you in-this house —

**34** then you, hear in-the-heavens, and-forgive the-sin-of your-people Israel, and-bring-them-back to the-land that you-gave to-their-fathers.

**35** When the-heavens are-shut-up and-there-is-no rain because they-sinned against-you, and-they-pray toward this place and-confess ʾet-your-name, and-from-their-sin they-turn-back because you-afflict-them —

**36** then you, hear in-the-heavens, and-forgive the-sin-of your-servants and-your-people Israel — for you-teach-them the-good way in-which they-should-walk — and-give rain upon your-land that you-gave to-your-people as-an-inheritance.

**37** Famine when-it-is in-the-land, pestilence when-it-is, blight, mildew, locust, caterpillar when-it-is; when his-enemy besieges-him in-the-land-of his-gates — any plague, any sickness —

**38** any prayer, any plea that belongs-to any man, to-all your-people Israel, who knows each-one the-plague-of his-own-heart and-spreads-out his-palms toward this house —

**39** then you, hear in-the-heavens, the-place-of your-dwelling, and-forgive, and-act, and-give to-each-man according-to all his-ways, whose heart you-know — for you alone know ʾet-the-heart-of all the-sons-of men —

**40** so-that they-may-fear you all the-days that they-live upon the-face-of the-land that you-gave to-our-fathers.

**41** And-also to the-foreigner who is not from-your-people Israel, and-he-comes from-a-far land for-the-sake-of your-name —

**42** for they-will-hear ʾet-your-great name and-ʾet-your-strong hand and-your-outstretched arm — and-he-comes and-prays toward this house —

**43** you, hear in-the-heavens, the-place-of your-dwelling, and-do according-to all that the-foreigner calls to-you, so-that all the-peoples-of the-earth may-know ʾet-your-name, to-fear you like your-people Israel, and-to-know that your-name is-called upon this house that I-have-built.

**44** When your-people go-out to-battle against their-enemy, in-the-way that you-send-them, and-they-pray to YHWH toward the-city that you-chose and-the-house that I-built for-your-name —

**45** then hear in-the-heavens ʾet-their-prayer and-ʾet-their-plea, and-do their-justice.

**46** When they-sin against-you — for there-is-no man who does-not sin — and-you-are-angry with-them and-give-them before an-enemy, and-their-captors take-them-captive to the-land-of the-enemy, far or near,

**47** and-they-take-it-to-heart in-the-land where they-were-taken-captive, and-they-return and-plead-for-grace to-you in-the-land-of their-captors, saying, 'We-have-sinned and-acted-perversely; we-have-done-wickedly,'

**48** and-they-return to-you with-all their-heart and-with-all their-soul in-the-land-of their-enemies who-took-them-captive, and-they-pray to-you toward their-land that you-gave to-their-fathers, the-city that you-chose, and-the-house that I-built for-your-name —

**49** then hear in-the-heavens, the-place-of your-dwelling, ʾet-their-prayer and-ʾet-their-plea, and-do their-justice,

**50** and-forgive your-people who sinned against-you, and-all their-transgressions that they-transgressed against-you, and-give-them compassion before their-captors, and-they-will-have-compassion on-them.

**51** For they are your-people and-your-inheritance, whom you-brought-out from-Egypt, from-the-midst-of the-furnace-of iron —

**52** that your-eyes may-be open to the-plea-of your-servant and-to the-plea-of your-people Israel, to-hear to-them in-all their-calling to-you.

**53** For you set-them-apart from-all the-peoples-of the-earth as-your-inheritance, as you-spoke by-the-hand-of Moses your-servant, when-you-brought-out ʾet-our-fathers from-Egypt, O-Lord YHWH."

**54** And-it-was, when-Solomon finished praying to YHWH ʾet-all this prayer and-this plea, he-arose from-before the-altar-of YHWH, from-kneeling on his-knees with-his-palms spread toward the-heavens.

**55** And-he-stood and-blessed ʾet-all the-assembly-of Israel with-a-loud voice, saying,

**56** "Blessed is YHWH, who has-given rest to-his-people Israel, according-to all that he-spoke. Not one word has-fallen from-all his-good word that he-spoke by-the-hand-of Moses his-servant.

**57** May YHWH our-God be with-us as he-was with our-fathers. May-he-not leave-us and-may-he-not forsake-us,

**58** to-incline our-hearts to-him, to-walk in-all his-ways, and-to-keep his-commandments and-his-statutes and-his-judgments that he-commanded ʾet-our-fathers.

**59** And-may these my-words, with-which I-pleaded before YHWH, be near to YHWH our-God day and-night, to-do the-justice-of his-servant and-the-justice-of his-people Israel, the-matter-of each-day in-its-day —

**60** so-that all the-peoples-of the-earth may-know that YHWH — he is the-God; there-is-no other.

**61** And-let your-heart be complete with YHWH our-God, to-walk in-his-statutes and-to-keep his-commandments, as-this day."

**62** And-the-king and-all Israel with-him were-sacrificing sacrifice before YHWH.

**63** And-Solomon sacrificed ʾet-the-sacrifice-of the-peace-offerings that he-sacrificed to-YHWH: twenty-two thousand cattle and-a-hundred and-twenty thousand sheep. And-the-king and-all the-sons-of Israel dedicated ʾet-the-house-of YHWH.

**64** On-that day the-king consecrated ʾet-the-middle-of the-court that was before the-house-of YHWH, for there he-made the-burnt-offerings and-the-grain-offerings and-the-fat-pieces-of the-peace-offerings, because the-bronze altar that was before YHWH was-too-small to-hold the-burnt-offerings and-the-grain-offerings and-the-fat-pieces-of the-peace-offerings.

**65** And-Solomon held the-feast at-that time, and-all Israel with-him — a-great assembly, from-the-entrance-of Hamath to the-brook-of Egypt — before YHWH our-God, seven days and-seven days: fourteen days.

**66** On-the-eighth day he-sent ʾet-the-people away, and-they-blessed the-king, and-went to-their-tents joyful and-good-of-heart over all the-good that YHWH had-done for-David his-servant and-for-Israel his-people.

---
## EMET Textual Notes

1. **8:9 — "nothing in-the-ark except the-two tablets"**: By Solomon's time, the jar of manna and Aaron's rod (Heb 9:4) were apparently no longer present. Only the covenant documents remain — the irreducible core.

2. **8:10-11 — the-cloud/the-glory**: The kavod (glory) of YHWH fills the temple as it once filled the tabernacle (Exod 40:34-35). The same divine presence that traveled with Israel in the wilderness now takes up permanent residence.

3. **8:27 — "the-heavens-of the-heavens cannot contain-you"**: Solomon's theological sophistication: the God for whom he builds cannot be contained by the building. This is the most advanced statement of divine transcendence in the Hebrew Bible to this point.

4. **8:41-43 — prayer for the foreigner**: Remarkably, Solomon's prayer includes non-Israelites. The temple is to be a place where foreigners encounter YHWH — anticipating Isaiah's "house of prayer for all peoples" (Isa 56:7).

5. **8:46-50 — prayer from exile**: Solomon envisions a scenario where Israel is taken captive and prays toward the land from afar. This prayer was written before the exile but reads as if composed for exiles — a prophetic intercession.

— EMET
